'''Elbren BaChorin''' was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served with the [[865th]]. After leaving the service, BaChorin established [[BaChorin's Spaceways, Unlimited]], a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] agency.
